resources.string: Data & Backup
Create backup
Save your aquariums, care records and eligible device assignments in an AquaLight backup.
Create an AquaLight backup of your aquarium data.
Restore from backup
Review an AquaLight backup and add its data without deleting your current aquariums.
Choose and restore an AquaLight backup.
Export my data
Create a readable JSON copy of your profile, selected app preferences, usage counters and aquarium data.
Export a readable copy of your AquaLight data.
Open data action

Backups never include passwords, authentication credentials, device security secrets or active device sessions. Restoring adds validated data to the currently signed-in account and never transfers device ownership.

Backup failed

Restore failed
